# ─────────────────────────────────────────────
# Triggers
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────
on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main

# ─────────────────────────────────────────────
# Global defaults
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────
env:
  NODE_VERSION: "20"
  IMAGE_NAME: ${{ github.repository }}   # e.g. "org/repo"

jobs:
  # ───────────────────────────────────────────
  # Job 1 – Lint
  # ───────────────────────────────────────────
  lint:
    name: Lint (ESLint)
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - name: Checkout source
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Node.js ${{ env.NODE_VERSION }}
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: ${{ env.NODE_VERSION }}
          cache: "npm"               # speeds up installs with npm cache

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci                  # clean, reproducible install from package-lock.json

      - name: Run ESLint
        run: npm run lint            # expects a "lint" script in package.json

  # ───────────────────────────────────────────
  # Job 2 – Test
  # ───────────────────────────────────────────
  test:
    name: Test (Jest)
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: lint                      # only run tests when linting passes

    steps:
      - name: Checkout source
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Node.js ${{ env.NODE_VERSION }}
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: ${{ env.NODE_VERSION }}
          cache: "npm"

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: Run Jest tests
        run: npm test                # expects a "test" script in package.json
        env:
          CI: true                   # Jest uses this flag to fail on unhandled warnings

      - name: Upload coverage report
        # Only upload when running against main so PR checks stay fast
        if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/main'
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: coverage-report
          path: coverage/            # default Jest coverage output directory
          retention-days: 14

  # ───────────────────────────────────────────
  # Job 3 – Docker build (main branch only)
  # ───────────────────────────────────────────
  docker:
    name: Build & Push Docker Image
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: test                      # only build when tests pass
    if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' && github.event_name == 'push'

    permissions:
      contents: read
      packages: write                # required for pushing to GHCR

    steps:
      - name: Checkout source
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

        uses: docker/login-action@v3
        with:
          registry: ghcr.io
          username: ${{ github.actor }}
          password: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}  # automatically provided by Actions

        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:

        run: npm ci

      # 4. Lint – runs the "lint" script defined in package.json
      #    Expected script: "lint": "eslint ."
      - name: Run ESLint
        run: npm run lint

      # 5. Test – runs the "test" script defined in package.json
      #    Expected script: "test": "jest --ci --coverage"
      - name: Run Jest tests
        run: npm test

  # ───────────────────────────────────────────
  # Job 2 – Build Docker Image
  # Runs ONLY on pushes to main (not on PRs)
  # Depends on lint-and-test passing first
  # ───────────────────────────────────────────

    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: lint-and-test                       # Gate: only run after tests pass

      # 1. Check out source code
